profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer/Solutions Architect with strong customer focus and deep expertise in designing and implementing efficient, scalable solutions within the highly regulated federal space. Strong background in large enterprise backend systems, system architecture, and complex problem-solving. Demonstrates methodical approach to development, with focus on optimizing performance and ensuring robust code quality. Brings passion for continuous learning and technical excellence.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Ok maybe a little platform architecting as well.

positions.title: Solutions Architect/Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a post sales SA within the SLED/Federal group helping clients convert their legacy software systems to a Microservice based system running on VMware Kubernetes with Tanzu developer platform or Pivotal Cloud Foundry
Lead client stakeholders through an Event Storm to break down the existing system into domains based upon domain driven design and discover the best domain/subsystem to start the conversion
Would then lead a team of client developers and possibly VMware supplement developers through the full SDLC using Agile/Scrum methods
Worked cross various groups; platform, security, infrastructure to insure software could be delivered on time
Taught a wide array of software development tools to the client developers like, but not limited to: Spring Boot, unit/integration tests, REST, gRPC, React, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, OpenAPI
Ensured software written was in compliance with industry regulations ex: FedRAMP, PII, PHI, HIPAA, etc
Would also guide the client developers to design and develop a reference CI/CD pipeline to work with the new microservices
Demonstrated how to track server health metrics such as CPU utilization, memory usage, and network traffic using monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana
Kept client stakeholders informed of progress to assure alignment between business and technical goals
Lead checkpoint presentations to client executives and high level military stakeholders at the end of the contract to display the value provided by the new architecture running on VMware/Tanzu developer platform
Completed above work well enough that all contracts that had a possibility of an extension received one
Highlights include: lead the re-architecture of one of the largest event driven system in the DoD and adding VOIP functionality to the VA app
Currently working as an Engineering Practice Lead at the Army Software Factory
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · PostgreSQL · Apache Kafka · Spring Boot · Microservices · React Native · REST APIs · Customer Satisfaction · Gradle · Representational State Transfer (REST) · TypeScript · JavaScript · JSON · Hibernate · MongoDB · DevSecOps · RabbitMQ · JSON Web Token (JWT) · GraphQL · gRPC · React.js · Team Leadership · Agile Project Management · Redis · Software Architecture · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Solutions Architect/Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microservices · React Native · Gradle · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JavaScript · JSON · Hibernate · JSON Web Token (JWT) · gRPC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in the user experience team as a full stack developer focusing mostly on the backend system in this fast moving start up. Designed and wrote the backend for the frontend system in order to fix timing issues that could occur between the event driven backend and synchronous user flow on the webpage.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microservices · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JavaScript · JSON · Hibernate · MongoDB · JSON Web Token (JWT) · gRPC · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Was in charge of gathering requirements, architecting, testing and supporting deployments of our suite of satellite scheduling microservices
Continued to maintain, monitor and add features to the existing satellite scheduling microservices
Lead a team of 5 other senior developers from multiple teams in creating an automated dependency management tool to auto update all Maven build microservices
Continued to lead the Java Community of Practice
Mentored junior developers on the team to write clean testable code
Contributed to defining how we would integrate AWS IAC into Maxar's CI/CD pipeline
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Spring Boot · Microservices · Agile Methodologies · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JSON · AngularJS · Hibernate · Elasticsearch · JSON Web Token (JWT) · Maven · Java · SAFE · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Was in charge of the design and coding of various microservices for the next generation ground system.  Later on was brought in to help with the design and coding of a cloud like subsystem to interact with the old J2EE based ground system.  Helped lead and design the Maven build process to make sure these microservices met security software approved guidelines.  Also, was put in charge of rewriting a key microservice, took processing time down from 5 minutes to a few seconds.  Lead the Java Community of Practice for Digital Globe.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JSON · Hibernate · Elasticsearch · JSON Web Token (JWT)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Under contract to DigitalGlobe to help develop their next generation ground system.  Wrote java code to be used in long running BPMN process flows.  Also wrote spring boot based front-end to interact with the rest of the cloud based system.  Wrote many base class/frameworks to help speed up other developers and tester.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JSON · Hibernate · JSON Web Token (JWT)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote Java code to translate system data between two different systems, took processing time down from 4 hours to 20 minutes.  Wrote various PL/SQL procedures as well as help define our backend data model.
